# Freshcoat Painting

> Top-rated painters and painting contractors in Christchurch, New Zealand. House painting, interior, exterior, and roof painting with 30+ years experience and a 5-year workmanship warranty.

Freshcoat Painting is a Christchurch-based painting company led by Michael Burke, a qualified painter with over 30 years of experience. The company serves residential and commercial clients across Christchurch and surrounding Canterbury suburbs, delivering premium interior painting, exterior house painting, roof painting, and new-build painting services. Every project is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty and a commitment to meticulous preparation, premium materials, and clean, reliable service.

Contact: Michael Burke at michael@freshcoat.co.nz or 022 036 6586. Based at 239 Clyde Road, Christchurch 8053.

## Services

- [Interior Painting](/interior): Residential interior painting including walls, ceilings, trim, doors, and detailed finishing for homes across Christchurch.
- [Exterior Painting](/exterior): Weatherboard, plaster, and exterior surface painting with thorough surface preparation and long-lasting protective coatings.
- [Roof Painting](/roof-painting): Roof restoration and repainting using specialized coatings designed for New Zealand conditions.
- [Commercial Painting](/commercial): Office, retail, and commercial property painting with minimal disruption to business operations.
- [House Preparation](/house-preparation): Surface cleaning, sanding, crack repair, priming, and full preparation before painting begins.
- [Painting Cost Guide](/painting-cost-guide): Transparent pricing guidance for house painting projects in Christchurch.
